en.topic_title: Philippines says China harassed its vessels in disputed waters
en.topic_summary:
The Philippines accused China’s coast guard of firing water cannon and using a “dangerous manoeuvre” on Thursday to block vessels bringing aid to Filipino fishermen near a disputed South China Sea reef.



The Philippine military accused the China Coast Guard of clubbing a Filipino sailor with a baton on Monday, July 20, 2026. Photo: Philippines Coast Guard.
